section.sectionSummaryBrief: It explains that the raising of the lamps, revealing the soul's ratzo ascent, is specifically through Aharon, who embodies the Torah's halachos, which illuminate this ascent.
section.t: And it is explained in the discourses,
that the reason for the raising of the lamps
[the revelation of the nature of ratzo and the ascent of the souls]
is specifically through Aharon,
for regarding Aharon it is written,
"Like the good oil upon the head, descending upon the beard, the beard of Aharon, descending upon the opening of his garments,"
and the concept of the "beard of Aharon" is the halachos of the Torah,
and through the Torah,
"Torah is light,"
the nature of the soul's ascent
(which exists even during its descent below and its enclothing in the body)
is revealed and illuminated, "when you raise the lamps."
And based on this, we can explain the connection of the Sages' statement
(cited in the maamar)
"If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp" to "when you raise the lamps,"
for the concept of "I will guard your lamp"
(guarding the lamp so it will not be extinguished)
is that the lamp of the soul
(the nature of its ratzo and ascent)
will be revealed,
and this guarding of the soul's lamp is through guarding the lamp of Torah, analogous to the concept of "when you raise the lamps" which is through Aharon,
Torah.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The maamar explains that the statement "If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp" is understood through a Midrash showing that the world was created for Israel, whose perfection is through Torah, and that by fulfilling the 613 mitzvos the soul ascends higher than before its descent.
section.t: And the maamar continues,
that we need to understand regarding "If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp,"
what is the connection between them, and moreover that they are dependent on each other.
And it explains this based on what is stated in the Midrash,
"In whose merit were 'These are the generations of the heavens and the earth' created?"
"And in whose merit do they stand?"
"In the merit of 'These are the names of the children of Israel,'"
"And these, in whose merit do they stand?"
"In the merit of 'These are the testimonies, statutes, and judgments.'"
That the intent is that the creation of the world is for the sake of Israel,
and the perfection of Israel is through the Torah.
For through Israel fulfilling the 613 mitzvos, they ascend to a higher level than they are in their own right.
And this is why the soul descends below and becomes enclothed in a physical body in order to fulfill Torah and mitzvos,
for through the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos, the soul ascends higher than it was before its descent.
And this is "If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp,"
that the guarding of the soul's lamp is through guarding the lamp of Torah.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: It connects the concept of the soul's ascent through Torah and mitzvos to a higher level than before its descent with the theme of "when you raise the lamps."
section.t: And based on what is written in the maamar, that the concept of "If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp" is that through fulfilling Torah and mitzvos the soul ascends higher than it was before its descent,
one can say,
that this connection of this concept with "when you raise the lamps,"
is,
for also the concept of "when you raise the lamps" is
the ascent that occurs in the souls to a level higher even than they were before their descent below.
